approval_scope: All source meanings examined. Apply corrections, resolve or explicitly retain provisional names, then perform fit and runtime checks. This report does not certify runtime fit or all licensed Roman spellings.
method: Read every Japanese/English row. Compare support name/category/trigger triples at ID offsets 100. Read the ability glossary, its notes and source links, and existing unit-name glossary spellings. Correct meaning loss and documented term inconsistency only; preserve valid alternative wording.

verified_interpretations: All AP thresholds use or less, preserving the inclusive Japanese 以下. Do not fit them as below.
Trigger IDs 383, 385, 390 and 391 describe missiles fired at the player; the player is the target, not the launcher.

IDs 106/206/306 preserve two paired effects and conditions: ongoing AP recovery and an area attack when AP is 10 percent or less. Source 306 does not explicitly repeat player; the English does not invent it.
ID 153 is simply Throw, source 投げ. ID 148 is the named Daisetsuzan Oroshi; it should not become a generic throw. Paired 247/248 and 347/348 are literal dash entries and should remain dashes.

Source developer descriptions 51-75 are placeholders; ID 61's tentative power-up and ID 65's Thought Control System should not be replaced by fabricated effects. ID 69 repeats description in the source, which the draft preserves.
Attack category Draw Enemy Fire agrees with paired diversion/decoy support names; it must not become weapon homing guidance.
Wing Caliber, G-Falcon, High Maneuver and Plamo Spirit agree with existing project glossary spellings; no stylistic rename requested.
Player surrounded and Player uses melee are compact but preserve their respective combat conditions. No meaning-only rewrite requested.

uncertainties.reason: The game's パッセル literally yields Passel. Official Gundam material confirms Justice Gundam has バッセル, but a similar-looking name alone does not prove this row is that weapon. Adjacent Freedom/METEOR-related support names suggest Justice context without conclusively establishing the owner.
uncertainties.recommendation: Resolve owner to Justice Gundam via game data or matching command-list context before normalizing to Bassel. If unresolved, retain explicit provisional status rather than calling it a confirmed typo.

uncertainties.reason: Translations/transliterations are consistent with the source reading and existing project terms where present. No independent primary English source was confirmed for every specialized move name. Preserve the glossary's provisional labels; do not represent these as universally licensed English forms. Specific unresolved forms include Vascud Crisis, Grave Cannon and Energy Shave.

Ringing the Staff refers specifically to the Buddhist ringed staff (shakujo). The draft's full_en records Ringing the Ringed Staff. No correction required unless visual context introduces a different kind of staff; exact licensed move name remains unconfirmed.
